"''This is a cargo ship. We have no passengers.''"
"''She's a meknek. Freelance outer ship repair. She bunks ship to ship.''"
"''Why would we have mekneks here? The Republic has legislated that only droids may perform outer ship repair—''" [Blex begins stammering as Fandar raises his hand]|quoteend=0|Yord Fandar and Blex|audio=Blex-Yord-LostFound.flac|}} '''Blex''' was a [[Neimoidian]] member of the [[Trade Federation]] who served as [[captain]] of the [[WD-2550 Whydah-class Yield Conveyer|WD-2550 ''Whydah''-class Yield Conveyer]] ''[[Fallon]]''. In [[132 BBY]], the [[freighter]] needed [[Deflector shield generator|shield generator]] repairs while in [[Realspace|space]] and the [[meknek]]s [[Verosha Aniseya]] and [[Fillik]] were sent onto the hull to carry out the work. As the repairs took place, Blex complained about how long it was taking and called the mekneks disposable, which Aniseya and Fillik heard over the [[Starship|ship's]] [[Comlink|comms]]. A [[Jedi Vector]] then docked with the ''Fallon'' and the [[Jedi]] [[Yord Fandar]] and [[Tasi Lowa]] approached Blex on the freighter's [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]], informing the captain that they were [[Mission to arrest Osha Aniseya|looking for Aniseya]]. Blex denied that she was on board as the use of mekneks for outer ship repairs was against [[Galactic Republic]] legislature; however, when Fandar prepared to [[Force power|use]] [[the Force]] on the captain, Blex's [[Executive officer|Chief Officer]] [[Queya]] provided the location of Aniseya's [[Bunk 23|bunk]]. ==Biography== ===Cruel captain=== {{Quote|What is taking so long? Activate the shield immediately.''"
"''Uh… The, uh, mekneks are on it, Captain.|Blex and Queya|audio=Blex-ActivateShields-LostFound.flac|}} Blex was a [[Neimoidian]] who worked for the [[Trade Federation]] during the [[High Republic Era]], serving as [[captain]] of the rugged and aging [[WD-2550 Whydah-class Yield Conveyer|WD-2550 ''Whydah''-class Yield Conveyer]] named the ''[[Fallon]]'',{{Databank|fallon-freighter|Fallon freighter}} which was used as a [[Transport|cargo vessel]]. In [[132 BBY]],{{TheAcolyteDate}} Blex fell behind on his revenue requirements shortly before a quarterly deadline and cut corners where he could in order to ensure a profitable run. He developed a stress ulcer that irritated his [[lung]] pods and caused him to frequently sigh in an exasperated fashion. When the [[freighter]] required repairs to its [[Deflector shield generator|shield generators]] while in [[Realspace|space]] and the job was given to the freelance [[human]] [[meknek]]s [[Verosha Aniseya]] and [[Fillik]], despite [[Galactic Republic]] legislation stating that only [[droid]]s could perform outer [[Starship|ship]] repairs. As the mekneks worked on the ship's exterior, Blex stood on the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] and complained about the [[time]] the repairs were taking, ordering that the [[Deflector shield|shields]] be immediately activated. [[File:Blex-Bridge-LostFound.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Wearing ornate robes, Blex stands on a raised area of the ''Fallon's'' bridge looking down a two Neimoidians at control stations. Queya stands behind Blex at the rear of the bridge.|Blex was captain of the ''Fallon'', a Trade Federation cargo freighter.]] Blex's [[Executive officer|Chief Officer]] [[Queya]] then informed him that the mekneks were working on the issue, prompting Blex to call the pair expendable, unlike the ship's precious cargo. However, the mekneks could hear the audio from the bridge through their [[Comlink|comms]], and Aniseya responded over the bridge's [[speaker]]s that while Fillik was disposable, she was not, causing Blex to groan. The mekneks then carried on with their work as a pressure valve blew, although Aniseya was able to repair it. ===The Jedi arrive=== {{Quote|To what do we owe the pleasure of Jedi presence on our humble ship?|Blex, to the Jedi|audio=Blex-HumbleShip-LostFound.flac|}} As the repair work continued, a [[Jedi Vector]] approached the ''Fallon'' and circled the ship while Blex and Queya watched from the bridge, both groaning as they recognized the [[starfighter]] as belonging to the [[Jedi Order]]. The Vector then docked with the freighter and [[Jedi Knight]] [[Yord Fandar]] and his [[Padawan]], [[Tasi Lowa]], disembarked and entered the ''Fallon's'' bridge. The captain greeted the pair, but when the [[Jedi]] informed the Neimoidians that they [[Mission to arrest Osha Aniseya|sought]] Aniseya, Blex lied and claimed the vessel had no passengers or mekneks, citing the Republic legislation on outer hull repairs. [[File:Yord-Blex-LostFound.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Yord Fandar raises a hand toward a surprised looking Blex on the bridge of the ''Fallon''.|Blex unsuccessfully attempted to deceive the Jedi.]] Fandar then raised his [[Limb|hand]] toward the captain to [[Force power|use]] [[the Force]], causing Blex to begin stammering and prompting the chief officer to quickly reveal where Aniseya's [[Bunk 23|bunk]] was located. The Jedi then departed the bridge and arrested Aniseya, transferring her to the [[DTE-CSA-17 Calaboose prison ship]] ''[[Palwick]]'',{{Databank|palwick-prison-ship|Palwick prison ship}} which had also docked with the ''Fallon''. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|The grease grubbers are disposable. Our cargo is not.|Blex|audio=Blex-GreaseGrubbers-LostFound.flac|}} [[File:Blex-LostFound.png|thumb|250px|left|Blex prioritized profit over all else.]] While commanding the ''Fallon'', Blex desperately desired promotion onto a larger class of ship that could make more profitable hauls; however, Queya considered him to have a dissapointing lack of foresight and strategy and was forced to cover his missteps until she could secure her own promotion elsewhere. Blex disregarded Republic rules and prioritized profits over the lives of his hired hands, considering the mekneks on the ''Fallon'' greasy and disposable. He groaned both when having to listen to the mekneks and upon seeing the Jedi arrive, which caused him to feel like [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] and stock options were disolving before his [[eye]]s. Despite this, he pretended to be welcoming and lied to them upon their arrival to hide the Republic legislations he had ignored. Blex had [[Color|green]] skin and red eyes. He stood 2.13 [[meter]]s tall. ==Equipment== While on the bridge of the freighter he commanded, Blex wore a draped blue and gold [[cloak]] of command with an aromatically infused collar and tiered golden epaulets with frills. His head was well-adorned with a black captain's campanulate [[hat]] with a golded crown and golden deocrations. Inside the cloak, he concealed a [[sonic stunner]] for self-defense. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|I was given the job of designing and building Captain Blex which was a really fun character to design but with the lack of space in the mask it was a challenging build but I was really happy with the final result.|Tim Berry|{{WookCite|url=p/4400000000003961302|text=Interview with Tim Berry|forum=1}}}} [[File:FreighterBridge-AdamBrockbank-Instagram.jpg|thumb|right|300px|alt=Concept art showing Blex, with a design similar to Rune Haako, standing on the bridge of the ''Fallon'' with Yord Fandar, who had his hair in a tight bun.|"Freighter bridge" by Adam Brockbank]] Blex first appeared in "[[Lost / Found]]," the first episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired [[June 4]], [[2024]], on [[Disney+]].{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}} The character's name was not spoken in the episode but appeared in its credits. Prior to the release of the episode, Blex was revealed in a trailer exclusively shown at [[Celebration Europe (2023)|Celebration Europe]]{{CelebrationTrailer|''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]''|Celebration Europe (2023)}} during the [[Lucasfilm]] Studio Showcase on [[April 7]], [[2023]].{{SW|url=news/swce-2023-lucasfilm-studio-showcase|text=SWCE 2023: 11 Highlights from Lucasfilm's Studio Showcase}} Concept artist [[Adam Brockbank]] produced two peices of concept art title "Neimoidian Freighter Bridge," both of which showed Blex, and costume concept illustrator [[Eleanor Barlow]] produced a costume study for the character.''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'' Performance artist [[James Henri-Thomas]] physically portrayed the character with [[Robin Atkin Downes]] providing the voice.{{Twitter|username=Robin_A_Downes|url=status/1799892845370695923|name=[[Robin Atkin Downes]]|date=2024-06-09|quote=One of my characters is in the trailer! Check out #TheAcolyte #StarWars #GreatGigs|archivedate=2024-06-19|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/ugp7B}} [[Mike Quinn]] provided the on-set voice reference and controlled the character's lip-syncing while [[Colin Purves]] and [[Adrian Parish]] controlled the eyes and brows of Blex's mask,{{Facebook|username=MikeQuinnOfficial|url=/photo/?fbid=996018152533320&set=a.120417703426707|name=[[Mike Quinn]]|date=2024-06-09|quote=🤩 I can finally reveal some of my involvement in the new smash series The Acolye, the new Star Wars show on Disney+. In the first two episodes alone I had three speaking characters and worked on three additional non speaking characters. It was intense I must say and both an immense privilege and a massive responsibility. This picture depicts the three dialogue characters in episode one, where I provided animatronic lip-synch and on set voice acting (reference guide voices) with the principle cast. One was for the noodle bartender, another for Captain Blex, the Niemoidian and the third for the prison convict. Performing wonderfully in the actual costumes themselves were Liam Cook (noodle guy and convict) and James Henri-Thomas (Niemoidian). Eyes and brows expertly performed by Colin Purves and Adrian Parish. Beautiful work from all the CFX team as always! Everyone worked so damn hard on this show and I love how it's turned out. So happy for everyone involved! 🥳|archivedate=2024-06-19|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/5Qlxw}} which was designed and built by [[Tim Berry]] with facial movements programed by [[Matt Denton]].{{Instagram|username=timatronics|url=p/C8KyF_CKYZq|name=[[Tim Berry]]|date=2024-06-13|quote=Captain Blex - Animatronic design and build by myself. Performed by the amazing James Henri-Thomas @jay_henri_tee and puppeteered by the legendary Mike Quinn @mikequinnstudios Facial movements programmed by Matt Denton @mantisrobot|archiveurl=https://archive.is/PIvlN|archivefile=File:TimBerry-BlexNoodles-Instagram.png}} Due to the lack of space in the mask, Berry found it a challenging build but enjoyed the process and was pleased with the final result. The scenes on the ''Fallon'' were shot at [[Shinfield Studios]],{{WebCite|url=https://www.fanthatracks.com/news/the-acolyte-a-journey-to-the-filming-locations-part-1-madeira|text=The Acolyte: A journey to the filming locations Part 1: Madeira|archivedate=20241204220147}} [[Wikipedia:England|England]].{{Lucasfilm|url=news/julian-foddy-acolyte|text=''The Acolyte'' Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Foddy}} ===Concept art gallery=== {{Gallery |source=''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'' |storyboards= |concept= File:EleanorBarlow-CaptainBlex-ArtOfTheAcolyte.png|"Captain Blex Costume Study" by [[Eleanor Barlow]] File:FreighterBridge-AdamBrockbank-Instagram.jpg|"Neimoidian Freighter Bridge" by [[Adam Brockbank]] File:AdamBrockbank-NeimoidianFreighterBridge-ArtOfTheAcolyte.png|"Neimoidian Freighter Bridge" by Adam Brockbank |digital= |in-progress= }} ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Blex|imagecat=Images of Blex}} *{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{CelebrationTrailer|''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]''|Celebration Europe (2023)}} {{1stp}} *{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-creature-shop-bazil-reveal|text=Inside ''The Acolyte'' Creature Shop: Meet Bazil, the Tynnan Tracker - First Details}} {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' *{{Topps|set=2025 Topps Star Wars Chrome|cardname=#15 - Captain Blex|link=https://www.ebay.com/itm/317329608395}} *[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles (second edition)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles'', second edition]] {{Po}} *''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'' *{{Databank|captain-blex|Captain Blex}} *{{Databank|fallon-freighter|Fallon freighter}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Blex |es=Blex |fr=Blex |ka=ბლექსი }} [[Category:Captains]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Neimoidians]] [[Category:Trade Federation members]]
